answer_block: Local SEO connects Google Business Profile management, website SEO, local content, reviews, citations, authority, technical health, geo-grid rank tracking and conversion measurement. why_matters_body: A customer may discover a business in Google Search, compare it on Maps, read reviews, visit a service page, ask an AI assistant for a shortlist and then call or book. Weakness at any stage can send that customer to a competitor. Local SEO should connect discovery, comparison, verification and action instead of reporting rankings in isolation.
